arithmetic: Adapter performs no floating-point arithmetic. Raw RTL QKV bits plus checkpoint constants are inputs; every golden intermediate is expected-only and never fed to a successor DUT.
fault_controls: Off by default. Checker-only opt-in bitflip/drop/duplicate/stale-die negative controls; never mutate source fixtures or DUT inputs.
latency: No added hardware or speed credit. Inherited vector fixture model262cycles is unmeasured; L2/CDC/service wait cycles and actual numerical consumers remain integration-owner obligations.

routing.consumer_read: global_row=partition_base+local_row; bank=quadrant-local producer; local-row16bits and canonical row18bits per frozen L2 model
routing.mapping: SM=die-local canonical QKV row//96; slice=SM//8; bank=SM%8; local_row=row%96. Head reads are explicit index mappings, including crossing SM partitions.
routing.physical_KV_address_allocation: unqualified; logical head-major FP8 bytes only; no invented HBM addresses

trace_contract: Accepted DUT outputs only, JSONL: die,boundary,index,bits,cycle. Exact bits/shape/order/width/identity and complete boundary census required. Trace provenance caller-supplied and source-pinned; checker success alone cannot certify RTL origin.
